{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm deduplication: number of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')

# Correct biomarker_final: batch B values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to get ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute mean of corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print(f'Mean week-12 biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}')"}
